evidence.sourceTitle: Revolut Completes Fundraising Process Establishing $75 Billion Valuation
evidence.shortExcerpt: Revolut announced completion of a share sale, valuing the company at $75 billion.

observedFacts.statement: Current employees were given the opportunity to sell as part of the employee share sale.
The transaction was led by Coatue, Greenoaks, Dragoneer, and Fidelity Management & Research Company, with NVentures also participating.
Transaction terms, share rights, preferences, dilution, discounts, transaction volume, and cap-table data were not disclosed.
Revolut announced completion of the share sale on 2025-11-24.
The share sale established an implied headline valuation of USD 75 billion.

evidence.sourceTitle: Revolut Group Holdings Ltd Annual Report 2025
evidence.shortExcerpt: The audited statements cover 2025 and report revenue, profit, total assets and customer liabilities.

observedFacts.statement: BDO LLP audited the 2025 financial statements and gave a true-and-fair-view opinion for the Group and Parent Company.
Net profit for the year ended 2025-12-31 was GBP 1,304,628 thousand.
Profit before tax for the year ended 2025-12-31 was GBP 1,713,273 thousand.
Revenue for the year ended 2025-12-31 was GBP 4,515,770 thousand.
The annual report reports 68.3 million retail customers for 2025.
At 2025-12-31, cash and cash equivalents were GBP 21,021,729 thousand and treasury investments were GBP 17,614,303 thousand.
